loftbuck.name: Loftbucks
loftbuck.look: Sure-footed climbers with shaggy coats and swept-back horns.

mistwing.name: Mistwings
mistwing.look: Broad gliding flyers with membrane wings and light, hollow bones.

ironback.name: Ironbacks
ironback.look: Huge, slow haulers with plated backs.

reedcat.name: Reedcats
reedcat.look: Lean, striped prowlers with tall reed ears and lamp-bright eyes.

delver.name: Delvers
delver.look: Stocky diggers with spade claws and small, deep-set eyes.

wadeskin.name: Wadeskins
wadeskin.look: Smooth-skinned waders and swimmers with webbed feet and long necks.

strider.name: Striders
strider.look: Long-legged desert runners with broad padded feet and a heat-shedding frill.

hearthling.name: Hearthlings
hearthling.look: Small, round, warm-bodied kith that glow faintly when content and keep a room warm.

treeloper.name: Treelopers
treeloper.look: Long-armed canopy climbers with hooked fore-claws and a gripping tail; they sleep hanging in the cloud forest.

brineback.name: Brinebacks
brineback.look: Slow, plated shore grazers whose hides crust over with salt crystal; they can smell fresh water through stone.

gloamer.name: Gloamers
gloamer.look: Soft-bodied grazers of caves and dusk with a glowing fringe along the throat that pulses with their mood.

bellower.name: Bellowers
bellower.look: Barrel-chested grazers with a drum-skin throat sac; a bellower's boom carries from one valley to the next.

species.name: Treeloper
species.look: Grey-green, the colour of wet bark; hangs by its tail to feed.

species.name: Orchard ringtail
species.look: Banded tail, russet face; the Free Towns let them strip the windfalls.

species.name: Spire loper
species.look: Pale and long-limbed, it climbs the bare rock of the spires.

species.name: Brineback
species.look: White-crusted plates and a slow, rolling walk through the marsh pans.

species.name: Dock brineback
species.look: Barnacled grey plates; dockhands use them to haul hulls up the slips.

species.name: Reef brineback
species.look: Plates grown through with pink crystal from the reefs around Osk.

species.name: Canal gloamer
species.look: Pale blue glow under the canal arches; the Sisters keep them by the beds.

species.name: Mine gloamer
species.look: Amber-lit; miners carry them because the light dims before bad air.

species.name: Dusk gloamer
species.look: Green glow over the fens at dusk; travellers have followed them into the mire.

species.name: Bellower
species.look: Brown and barrel-chested; each Free Town's bellower calls the vote.

species.name: Warbellower
species.look: Scarred, armoured with leather; Tarsis companies march to its boom.

species.name: Lorne bellower
species.look: Shaggy black winter coat; its boom warns the passes when strangers come.

species.name: Hatchery gloamer
species.look: Bred by the Guild to light the brood rooms without heat. Dull white, glows without warmth.

species.name: Parade strider
species.look: Tall and plumed, bred for royal processions in Vantry; useless in the desert.

species.name: Culvert delver
species.look: Black with soot, bred to clear the mill culverts and live in the dark.

species.name: Market reedcat
species.look: Small, quick, patchy; every stall at Millbridge has one, and so does every thief.

species.name: Basket mistwing
species.look: Short-winged and strong, bred to carry moss baskets between terraces.

species.name: Vault ironback
species.look: Squat and immovable; Corvane banks chain one in every vault.

species.name: Hollin climber
species.look: Bred in the Free Towns' orchards to pick the high branches; gentle with children.

species.name: Physic hearthling
species.look: Kept in College infirmaries; it lies against the sick and warms them through.

species.name: Cliff bellower
species.look: Grey as the forts; Drevka clans relay news from peak to peak with its boom.

species.name: Garden gloamer
species.look: Bred for colour in the princes' night gardens: gold, rose, violet.

species.name: Tarsis warcat
species.look: Heavy-shouldered, bred for war; Tarsis rents them out with the company.

species.name: Smuggler wadeskin
species.look: Dark and silent, it swims cargo under the harbour chain at night.

species.name: Lorne border buck
species.look: Lorne's patrol mount: heavy coat, short horns, trained to stop at a word.

species.name: Cloud bellower
species.look: Its call is half a song; the Spire Folk trade melodies carried across the cloud sea.

species.name: Gallery wadeskin
species.look: White and eyeless, from the flooded galleries; it finds its way by touch.

species.name: Black-sand delver
species.look: Glossy black; it burrows in Osk's volcanic beaches.

species.name: Saltwing
species.look: White as the pans, it glides low over the salt marshes.

species.name: Drover strider
species.look: Runs beside the last ironback herds and keeps the stragglers in.

species.name: Fog reedcat
species.look: Grey on grey; it hunts in the cloud and is only seen when it wants to be.

species.name: Snow strider
species.look: Thick-furred feet and a short frill; it runs the passes all winter.

species.name: Gorge loper
species.look: It swings along the gorge walls on roots and ledges.

species.name: Bog hearthling
species.look: Burrows into warm, rotting peat; smells terrible, is very loved.

species.name: Pan brineback
species.look: Lives on the dry salt pans of the deep desert, drinking from crystal.

species.name: Gale mistwing
species.look: Narrow-winged, it flies into storms that ground every other kith.

species.name: Drove buck
species.look: Bred for the long droves; it follows a bell for weeks without tiring.

species.name: Palace hearthling
species.look: Silk-soft and pampered; kept in palace bedchambers.

species.name: King's courier
species.look: Gold-banded wings; carries the Crown's letters and nothing else.

species.name: Ledger cat
species.look: Keeps rats from the archives and can smell a forged page.

species.name: Coin delver
species.look: Small and greedy-nosed; bankers use it to find buried hoards.

species.name: Specimen gloamer
species.look: Its glow changes colour near the sick; College doctors read it like a chart.

species.name: Ward wadeskin
species.look: Lives in the College's healing baths and holds the weak up in the water.

species.name: Stormhorn
species.look: Its horns hum before lightning; it has never been struck.

species.name: Spark hearthling
species.look: Crackles when touched; it stores the storm's warmth in its fur.

species.name: Bell ironback
species.look: Carries the great drove bell; the whole drove follows its sound.

species.name: Drove cat
species.look: Follows the droves for scraps and guards the herd at night.

species.name: Warden tracker
species.look: Bred by the Guild to track runaways from the hatcheries.

species.name: Ferry ironback
species.look: Pulls the Millbridge ferry rope back and forth all day.

species.name: Ridge hearthling
species.look: Kept in fort hearths; Drevka children sleep curled round them.

species.name: Siege delver
species.look: Tarsis hires them out to bring walls down from below.

species.name: Ice-cave gloamer
species.look: Cold blue light from Lorne's ice caves.

species.name: Candle hearthling
species.look: Sleeps in the candle niches of the galleries and sits with the dying.

species.name: Plateau bellower
species.look: Its call brings the scattered herd back together at dusk.

species.name: Veil mistwing
species.look: Flies inside the cloud itself; wild lulls cling to its belly.

species.name: Pass ironback
species.look: Small for an ironback and shaggy; it ploughs the passes open.

species.name: Torrent wadeskin
species.look: Swims the gorge rapids that drown everything else.

species.name: Glidebuck
species.look: A horned climber with gliding flaps from wrist to flank; it leaps off terraces and glides down.

species.name: Ironhorn
species.look: A loftbuck's build carrying an ironback's plates and heavy horns.

species.name: Ridgecat
species.look: A long-legged, horned cat that hunts along ridgelines.

species.name: Warmfleece
species.look: Thick, warm fleece and a gentle face; it sleeps against the cold.

species.name: Stormkite
species.look: Long-legged and wide-winged; it runs to take off and rides desert storms.

species.name: Heronskin
species.look: Long neck, webbed feet and short wings; it wades and fishes the shallows.

species.name: Emberwing
species.look: A small flyer that glows warm in flight; lamps in the night sky.

species.name: Tunnel ram
species.look: A plated digger with a ram's head; it breaks rock with its brow.

species.name: Bargebull
species.look: A broad, plated swimmer that tows barges against the current.

species.name: Dunehorn
species.look: A plated runner of the sands with a frill and short horns.

species.name: Ottercat
species.look: A sleek, swimming cat with webbed paws and whiskers like reeds.

species.name: Sandcat
species.look: A pale, big-eared cat with padded feet for hot sand.

species.name: Burrowcat
species.look: A short-legged, spade-clawed cat that hunts underground.

species.name: Mudwarden
species.look: A heavy, mud-caked digger of riverbanks; it builds dams.

species.name: Kilnmole
species.look: A warm-bodied digger whose burrows stay warm all winter.

species.name: Steamstrider
species.look: A long-legged runner that steams in the cold and warms whoever rides it.

species.name: Canopy glider
species.look: Climbs to the top of the canopy and glides to the next tree.

species.name: Branchcat
species.look: A striped climber that hunts from the branches.

species.name: Crag swinger
species.look: Horned and long-armed; nothing climbs rock better.

species.name: Nestwarmer
species.look: Builds warm nests high in the trees and lets others in.

species.name: Lamp loper
species.look: Hangs in the canopy at night like a lantern.

species.name: Surfplate
species.look: Plated and sleek, it rides breaking waves to shore.

species.name: Bulwark
species.look: The heaviest kith there is; armies build lines around them.

species.name: Saltminer
species.look: Digs salt seams and grows them on its back.

species.name: Flatsrunner
species.look: Light plates, long legs; it crosses salt flats at a run.

species.name: Foghorn
species.look: Ports keep one on the breakwater to boom through fog.

species.name: Glowburrow
species.look: Lights its own tunnels as it digs.

species.name: Starwing
species.look: Flies at night with a glowing fringe; people make wishes on them.

species.name: Glowskin
species.look: Shines under water; fishermen follow it to shoals.

species.name: Emberglow
species.look: Warm and lit like a coal; a whole room's comfort.

species.name: Warhorn
species.look: Plated, booming, slow; the Drevka march to war behind them.

species.name: Echo buck
species.look: Its call comes back from every terrace; herds follow it.

species.name: Thunder runner
species.look: Booms as it runs; the sound arrives before it does.

species.name: Roarcat
species.look: A cat with a voice like a drum. Wild ones are feared.

species.name: Beacon
species.look: Light and boom together: the army's signal post on legs.

species.name: Canopy crier
species.look: Calls from the treetops when anything enters the forest.

recipe.hint: Hesk swears he once saw a loftbuck graze by moonlight and leave no tracks.
The Spire Folk sing of a buck with a crest like a blade of moonlight.
A storm-crested feather, they say, makes the bird that wears its colours.
Freed hatchery children talk of a bird that lived in the boiler smoke.
Two old ironbacks, the Drevka say, can sire one that never ages.
Ashby dockers swear a white cat with no shadow walks the salt quays.
Old miners say something digs below the deepest seam, and listens.
On Osk they say a wadeskin born there shines like the inside of a shell.
Court poets write of a strider seen only in the heat shimmer.
Oda says the caves at Larkfold once had a hearthling the colour of moss.
A creature lulls won't bite. Ume thinks it's a children's story.
Rhea's mother sang to the foals. One, they say, sang back.

species.name: Ghost loper

recipe.hint: Hesk's mother said some treelopers are never seen by day at all.

species.look: Translucent grey, it is hard to see even when you look straight at it.

species.name: Crystal brineback

recipe.hint: The Salt House keeps one crystal shell under glass and won't say where it came from.

species.look: Its plates are clear crystal; light splits into colours through them.

species.name: Deep gloamer

recipe.hint: The Sisters say the oldest gloamers in the galleries once had young that never came up.

species.look: Huge and slow, with a glow so soft it calms anyone who sees it.

species.name: Anthem bellower

recipe.hint: The Spire Folk have a song only a bellower can sing, and no bellower that knows it.

species.look: It sings rather than booms; armies weep when it does.

species.name: Royal strider

recipe.hint: The Crown's stud book has a page torn out: a strider that ran the desert and the parade both.

species.look: Plumed and frilled in gold; it carries itself like a king and runs like a desert wind.

species.name: Black glass delver

recipe.hint: Islanders on Osk talk of a delver that digs through rock like it was sand and leaves glass behind.

species.look: Glossy black with glassy claws that leave fused tunnels.

species.name: Iron matron

recipe.hint: The herders say a vault-born ironback once walked out of Corvane and joined the herd, and led it.

species.look: Massive, scarred, calm; other kith gather round it.

species.name: Night-garden glow

recipe.hint: A prince's gardener claims to have bred a light that heals what it touches. He was executed for it.

species.look: Shifts through every colour; plants grow towards it.

species.name: Smuggler's ghost

recipe.hint: Ashby harbour has a story about a wadeskin that steals from ships that are being watched.

species.look: Ink-black with no shine at all; it seems to swallow lamplight.

species.name: Pardon buck

recipe.hint: Lorne's border guards tell of a buck that walked prisoners home, and no one stopped it.

species.look: Silver-grey with a white blaze; people trust it on sight.

species.name: Gale crest

recipe.hint: Vael's oldest song names a crest that flew through the great storm and came back.

species.look: Crested in silver, narrow-winged, with storm-blue eyes.

species.name: Fen lantern

recipe.hint: Travellers who follow fen lights mostly drown. One came back riding one.

species.look: A wading gloamer whose glow shows only the safe ground.

species.name: War drummer

recipe.hint: Tarsis captains drink to a beast that broke a line with its voice alone.

species.look: Heavy, armoured, with a cat's claws and a war drum for a chest.

species.name: First Light
species.look: A gloamer the size of a barge, lighting a flooded hall like daybreak.

species.name: The Salt King
species.look: Centuries old, its plates grown into a crown of salt.

traits.silver-crest: Brighter song effects; needed for rare breeds
traits.loyal: Never bolts while its partner stands
traits.song-touched: Answers the foal song from further away
traits.stubborn-heart: Hard to calm, hard to break
traits.lull-scarred: Was worn by a lull; won't take one again
traits.bone-sickness: Inherited pain; can't fight or race, but steadies every kith around it
